name: How can I prevent mold and odors after a wet carpet incident?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent mold and odors after a wet carpet incident?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent mold and odors after a wet carpet incident, rapid and thorough drying is paramount. Even if the surface feels dry, moisture can linger in the padding or subfloor, creating an ideal environment for mold. Professional water damage restoration companies use specialized equipment to ensure all layers are completely dry, preventing fungal growth. They may also apply antimicrobial treatments to inhibit mold and mildew. Proper ventilation and addressing the source of the leak permanently are also crucial steps in preventing future issues and associated odors.
